finding: D10: opt-in verified artifact identity and executable model profiles
public_api: ModelIdentity::validate(expected_kind); bindings derives on all four types
InferenceBackend::model_identity(kind) returns verified pins/profile or explicit UnverifiedLegacy
verified_behavior: Schema1 typed manifests pin exact lowercase SHA256 for model and tokenizer; bounds: JSON16KiB, model1GiB, tokenizer64MiB, tokens1..4096, bounded exact supported labels.

Strict loaders validate and hash the same immutable bytes passed to ORT/tract and tokenizer parsing. Native strict loading uses commit_from_memory; directory files are read through bounded opened handles.
Graph checks enforce input_ids/attention_mask plus optional token_type_ids, int64 rank2 inputs, one float32 output, expected rank and static class count.
Shared v1 preprocessing rejects tokenizer-side padding/truncation, uses special tokens, declared right-padding ID, zero padding masks/types, and per-row token caps.
Declared NLI/emotion/NER label permutations remap into existing canonical outputs; unknown/duplicate/missing labels and kind/profile/version mismatches fail closed.

Verified replacements publish either the prepared model or the failure atomically, drop previous model outside the slot lock, and increment process cache generation under that lock; failed pins cannot retain an active old model.
Legacy loaders retain fixed-label behavior and explicitly report UnverifiedLegacy with no pinned manifest. Custom backends default to unverified after availability checking.

integration_notes: Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock are parent-owned; optional sha2 and serde_json under onnx were copied unchanged from root.
New examples/export_standalone_contracts.rs was copied unchanged from root only to satisfy Cargo manifest parsing; exclude it from this patch.
No Cargo stanza is needed for the Node WASI test runner. The runner preopens only the repository directory for the test WASM.
Root owns facade provenance wiring, generation bracketing, schema/TS exports, documentation and final full feature/MSRV gates.
limits: Pinned manifests must come from a caller-trusted source. Verification proves artifact/configuration binding and supported contract checks, not model training, semantic accuracy or calibration.
Actual native and WASM tract fixture runs use untrained constant/Cast graphs; trained-model and browser-host numerical parity are not established.
Strict verified models must be self-contained ONNX with supported inputs/output; external data and other architectures require another explicit profile. Legacy directory behavior is preserved.
Native and WASM use different tokenizer library versions. Shared preprocessing and tested fixture parity do not establish equivalence for every HuggingFace tokenizer component.
Identity and inference are separate calls; callers associating provenance across concurrent model changes must bracket with model_generation, which the parent is wiring into the facade.
Serialized artifact/input/output limits do not sandbox arbitrary graph execution or prove peak runtime memory/latency budgets.
Child validation uses Rust1.96; parent runs native1.92, WASM1.91 and core1.89 MSRV gates.
